addedLines: - claude: Catch-all for any task that doesn't fit a more specific agent. FleetView's default when no agent name is typed. (Tools: *)

- claude-code-guide: Use this agent when the user asks questions ("Can Claude...", "Does Claude...", "How do I...") about: (1) Claude Code (the CLI tool) - features, hooks, slash commands, MCP servers, settings, IDE integrations, keyboard shortcuts; (2) Claude Agent SDK - building custom agents; (3) Claude API (formerly Anthropic API) - API usage, tool use, Anthropic SDK usage. **IMPORTANT:** Before spawning a new agent, check if there is already a running or recently completed claude-code-guide agent that you can continue via SendMessage. (Tools: Glob, Grep, Read, WebFetch, WebSearch)

- Explore: Read-only search agent for broad fan-out searches — when answering means sweeping many files, directories, or naming conventions and you only need the conclusion, not the file dumps. It reads excerpts rather than whole files, so it locates code; it doesn't review or audit it. Specify search breadth: "medium" for moderate exploration, "very thorough" for multiple locations and naming conventions. (Tools: All tools except Agent, Artifact, ExitPlanMode, Edit, Write, NotebookEdit)

- general-purpose: General-purpose agent for researching complex questions, searching for code, and executing multi-step tasks. When you are searching for a keyword or file and are not confident that you will find the right match in the first few tries use this agent to perform the search for you. (Tools: *)

- Plan: Software architect agent for designing implementation plans. Use this when you need to plan the implementation strategy for a task. Returns step-by-step plans, identifies critical files, and considers architectural trade-offs. (Tools: All tools except Agent, Artifact, ExitPlanMode, Edit, Write, NotebookEdit)
- statusline-setup: Use this agent to configure the user's Claude Code status line setting. (Tools: Read, Edit)

- deep-research: Deep research harness — fan-out web searches, fetch sources, adversarially verify claims, synthesize a cited report. - When the user wants a deep, multi-source, fact-checked research report on any topic. BEFORE invoking, check if the question is specific enough to research directly — if underspecified (e.g., "what car to buy" without budget/use-case/region), ask 2-3 clarifying questions to narrow scope. Then pass the refined question as args, weaving the answers in.
- dataviz: Use this skill whenever you are about to create ANY chart, graph, plot, dashboard, or data visualization, in ANY output medium — an HTML or React artifact, inline SVG, plotting code in any library (matplotlib, plotly, d3, Recharts, …), an image/PNG you will render and upload, or a chart shared into Slack. Read it BEFORE writing the first line of chart code, choosing chart colors, building a stat tile / meter / KPI row, or laying out a dashboard. Produces visualizations that read as one system — elegant, accessible, consistent in light and dark — using a brand-neutral placeholder palette you swap for your own. Teaches a design-system-agnostic method: a form heuristic, a color formula with a runnable validator, mark specs, and interaction rules. A validated default palette is documented in `references/palette.md` — swap that file's values for your brand's. Triggers on: "chart", "graph", "plot", "data viz", "visualization", "dashboard", "analytics", "visualize data", "categorical colors", "sequential / diverging palette", "stat tile", "sparkline", "heatmap", "legend", "axis", "tooltip", "chart colors", "color by series".
- artifact-design: Design guidance and fundamentals for Artifacts.
- update-config: Use this skill to configure the Claude Code harness via settings.json. Automated behaviors ("from now on when X", "each time X", "whenever X", "before/after X") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. Also use for: permissions ("allow X", "add permission", "move permission to"), env vars ("set X=Y"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. Examples: "allow npm commands", "add bq permission to global settings", "move permission to user settings", "set DEBUG=true", "when claude stops show X". For simple settings like theme/model, suggest the /config command.
- keybindings-help: Use when the user wants to customize keyboard shortcuts, rebind keys, add chord bindings, or modify ~/.claude/keybindings.json. Examples: "rebind ctrl+s", "add a chord shortcut", "change the submit key", "customize keybindings".
- verify: Verify that a code change actually does what it's supposed to by exercising it end-to-end and observing behavior — drive the affected flow, not just tests or typecheck. Run before committing nontrivial changes; bootstraps this repo's project verify skill if none exists yet. Don't invoke it on a diff that only touches tests, docs, or other code with no runtime surface to drive (a change to product source always has one) — there's nothing to observe.
- code-review: Review the current diff for correctness bugs and reuse/simplification/efficiency cleanups at the given effort level (low/medium: fewer, high-confidence findings; high→max: broader coverage, may include uncertain findings). Pass --comment to post findings as inline PR comments, or --fix to apply the findings to the working tree after the review.
- simplify: Review the changed code for reuse, simplification, efficiency, and altitude cleanups, then apply the fixes. Quality only — it does not hunt for bugs; use /code-review for that.
- fewer-permission-prompts: Scan your transcripts for common read-only Bash and MCP tool calls, then add a prioritized allowlist to project .claude/settings.json to reduce permission prompts.
- loop: Run a prompt or slash command on a recurring interval (e.g. /loop 5m /foo). Omit the interval to let the model self-pace. - When the user wants to set up a recurring task, poll for status, or run something repeatedly on an interval (e.g. "check the deploy every 5 minutes", "keep running /babysit-prs"). Do NOT invoke for one-off tasks.
- schedule: Create, update, list, or run scheduled cloud agents (routines) that execute on a cron schedule. - When the user wants to schedule a recurring cloud agent, set up automated tasks, create a cron job for Claude Code, or manage their scheduled agents/routines. Also use when the user wants a one-time scheduled run ("run this once at 3pm", "remind me to check X tomorrow").
- claude-api: Reference for the Claude API / Anthropic SDK — model ids, pricing, params, streaming, tool use, MCP, agents, caching, token counting, model migration.
TRIGGER — read BEFORE opening the target file; don't skip because it "looks like a one-liner" — whenever: the prompt names Claude/Anthropic in any form (Claude, Anthropic, Fable, Opus, Sonnet, Haiku, `anthropic`, `@anthropic-ai`, `claude-*`, `us.anthropic.*`, `[1m]`); the user asks about an LLM (pricing/model choice/limits/caching) — never answer from memory; OR the task is LLM-shaped with provider unstated (agent/MCP/tool-definition/multi-agent/RAG/LLM-judge/computer-use; generate/summarize/extract/classify/rewrite/converse over NL; debugging refusals/cutoffs/streaming/tool-calls/tokens).
SKIP only when another provider is being worked on (overrides all triggers): OpenAI/GPT/Gemini/Llama/Mistral/Cohere/Ollama named in the query; OR `grep -rE 'openai|langchain_openai|google.generativeai|genai|mistralai|cohere|ollama'` over the project hits (run this grep FIRST if no provider named — don't Read the file).
- run: Launch and drive this project's app to see a change working. Use when asked to run, start, or screenshot the app, or to confirm a change works in the real app (not just tests). First looks for a project skill that already covers launching the app; otherwise falls back to built-in patterns per project type (CLI, server, TUI, Electron, browser-driven, library).
- init: Initialize a new CLAUDE.md file with codebase documentation
- review: Review a GitHub pull request; for your working diff use /code-review
- security-review: Complete a security review of the pending changes on the current branch

content.content: 1 --- 2 name: haiwaicang-fahuo-flow 3 description: 海外仓订单发货业务流程与自动化项目（Sellfox ERP + 海外仓WMS）的关键规则 4 metadata: 5 node_type: memory 6 type: project 7 originSessionId: dce5b0ea-d0d2-42df-858e-039f76260a64 8 --- 9 10 项目：把「海外仓订单发货」流程做成操作手册 + 全自动脚本（Playwright+Python）。依据操作录屏 `E:\project\海外仓\2026-07-08 09-47-00.mp4`。 11 12 **两个系统** 13 - Sellfox ERP：`www.sellfox.com/amzup-web-main/web/orderShip/index.html`，账号 17312292726 —— 订单处理/确认发货/扣库存/提交平台/获取跟踪单号。 14 - 海外仓WMS：`193.112.93.60:9999/index.html#` —— 一件代发>平台订单/批量修改快递方/批量发货。两个账号=两个店铺：JMSM=金猫、JMCAT=黑猫。 15 16 **主流程**：ERP 确认发货（弹窗"已选N个包裹，会扣减库存并提交平台"→确定）→ WMS 一件代发>平台订单 筛"未发货"→勾选→批量修改快递方→批量发货（Tip:预发货成功）→ 回 ERP 获取跟踪单号。 17 18 **⚠️ 编排必须按渠道串行（关键业务规则，用户口述 2026-07-08）**：ERP 物流下单**必须分渠道**下单——按渠道筛选待处理→只对该渠道下单→**紧接着**去 WMS 对该渠道对应店铺账号 改快递方+批量发货，**走完一个渠道的完整链路(ERP下单→WMS发货)后，再做下一个渠道**。不能一次性全渠道下单再统一发货。原因：不同渠道对应不同店铺(金猫/黑猫)→不同 WMS 账号→不同快递方优先级，混在一起会串。（→ run_shipping 要改成 per-渠道 循环：ERP filter_by_channel→place_logistics_orders→WMS process_shop(该渠道店铺)，逐渠道闭环。之前我做成了全渠道一次性，是错的。） 19 20 **快递方规则/渠道映射（用户确认 2026-07-08）**：ERP「全部渠道」下拉里每个渠道 = 仓库账号+快递方，渠道名本身编码了归属： 21 - 含 `BLACKCAT` → 黑猫 JMCAT；含 `昇新海外仓-昇新海外仓`(非BLACKCAT) → 金猫 JMSM。快递方=渠道名末段(-RM/-DPD/-EH)。 22 - 已见渠道：`昇新海外仓-BLACKCAT-RM/-DPD/-EH`(黑猫)、`昇新海外仓-昇新海外仓-RM/-DPD`(金猫)。 23 - 渠道决定**去哪个 WMS 账号**（BLACKCAT→黑猫JMCAT，昇新昇新→金猫JMSM）。 24 - **⚠️ 渠道末段快递方 = WMS 批量修改快递方，一一对应（用户澄清 2026-07-09，推翻旧「轮转重试」！）**：ERP 用哪个末段渠道下单，WMS 这批单就改成那个快递方——`-RM`渠道→WMS改RM、`-DPD`→改DPD、`-EH`→改EH。**不再 RM→DPD→EH 轮转试错**（ERP 已按快递方分渠道下单，每批单的快递方本就唯一确定）。→ 正好解释今早金猫`-DPD`渠道代码却先试RM是错的，应直接改DPD。 25 - ~~已作废(2026-07-08旧记录)：WMS 按账号优先级 黑猫RM→DPD→EH / 金猫RM→DPD 轮转重试~~——被上一条推翻，勿再用。**✅ 单一快递方改造已落地并自测通过(2026-07-09)**：新增 `rules.channel_courier(渠道末段→RM/DPD/EH)`；`wms.process_shop(page,account,courier)` 加 courier 参数、改为「全选→改成该快递方→重新全选→批量发货一次」，失败留存不换（去掉 `for courier in priority` 轮转）；`run_pipeline` 传 `rules.channel_courier(channel)`；`courier_priority` 标注弃用；`capture/wms_rotation_selftest.py` 重写测新逻辑(5用例全过)。py_compile+渠道映射+自测均过。⚠️前提：依赖「分渠道串行闭环」使 WMS 未发货此刻只有本渠道刚下的单——若混入残留单会被一起改快递方发货(残留清理是另一个待办)。 26 **✅ DRY 端到端已验证(2026-07-09 10:55)**：每有单渠道 WMS 只选其对应单一快递方(BLACKCAT-RM→黑猫RM、昇新-RM→金猫RM、昇新-DPD→金猫DPD)，无轮转、账号映射对、空渠道跳过、无失败留存；今早残留单已清空(金猫/黑猫未发货均0)。真跑的 WMS 真实动作(改快递方+批量发货)因 DRY 无单仍未验证。 27 **⚠️ 覆盖率缺口(2026-07-09 待排查)**：本次待处理共 17 单，5 个 CHANNEL_ORDER 只筛出 9 单(BLACKCAT-RM1+昇新RM7+昇新DPD1)，另 ~8 单渠道不在列表(可能 FEDEX/未知/空渠道)→**有漏发风险**。今早真跑也有(13单只覆盖4单)。需列出「待处理」各渠道分布，确认漏的是什么渠道、要不要补进 CHANNEL_ORDER。 28 **空渠道轮询已优化**：`erp.count_orders` range(20)→range(5)，空渠道判空从 ~23s 降到 ~8s（10:55 那次空跑跑的还是旧代码故仍 23s，下次生效）。 29 - **失败订单处理（用户确认 A，2026-07-09）**：某渠道用其对应快递方在 WMS 发货失败的单、以及 ERP 物流下单失败的单（缺货/SKU未配对等），**不换别的快递方、不挪别的渠道**（快递方由ERP渠道定死，WMS不自作主张降级），一律**留存记录 + 提醒用户**，再继续下一个渠道。 30 - FEDEX 暂不在常规规则内。（JMSM=金猫，JMCAT=黑猫；视频里登录的是黑猫。） 31 32 **自动化决策**：范围=ERP+WMS全程；先 DRY_RUN 空跑确认无误再开真发。技术=Playwright+Python(已装 chromium)。项目在 `E:\project\海外仓\automation\`。凭据在 `secrets.py`。 33 34 **关键技术结论（实测）**： 35 - WMS：无验证码，账号自动登录 OK。平台订单页实体 = `http://193.112.93.60:9999/orderInfo/page/orderInfo.html`（iframe内容页，可直连）。Element UI，按钮用文本选择器。 36 - ERP：登录有【图形验证码 + 腾讯滑块(turing.captcha.qcloud.com)】→ 无法无人自动登录。改用【手动登录一次+复用会话】：`capture/erp_manual_login.py` 持久化 profile，`core.ensure_erp` 用 `isLogin.json` 校验会话。会话失效才需重登。 37 - ERP 是多阶段流水线：待审核→待处理→物流下单[自营/三方仓]→待打单→已发货。变更类(审核通过/确认发货)风险高，默认 DRY_RUN。**待与业务确认要自动化到哪一步**。 38 - ddddocr 对赛狐图形验证码~62%，但滑块过不了，故放弃 OCR 登录方案。 39 40 **ERP 订单表是 vxe-table，不是 Element UI el-table（关键）**：旧 `.el-table__row`/`.el-pagination__total`/`.el-table__header .el-checkbox` 全部读不到，是踩过的坑。正确选择器（2026-07-08 实测）： 41 - 订单总数：`.total_style`（自定义分页把「共 N 条」拆成 `共N条`，异步加载需轮询等 total>0，页面有多个分页实例取 max）。兜底 `.parentRowGroup` 计数（每单一个）。 42 - 表头全选：`.vxe-header--column.col--checkbox .vxe-cell--checkbox`，点后用 `.vxe-body--row.row--checked, .vxe-cell--checkbox.is--checked` 计数校验。 43 - 行复选框有一半 `vxe-cell--checkbox is--disabled`（如 24 中 12 禁用）= vxe 固定列重复渲染的副本，**不是业务限制**，别被吓到。 44 - 物流下单按钮：行内也有同名按钮，必须点工具栏批量按钮 → 排除 `.vxe-body--row` 内、取 y 最小的可见按钮（见 erp.py `_find_toolbar_button`）。**关键坑：必须用 Playwright 真实点击(elementhandle.click)，`page.evaluate(el.click())` 的 JS 合成点击不触发 Vue 事件、静默失败=0 单！** 全选也一样用 elementhandle.click。 45 - 物流下单点击即执行、**无二次确认**，直接弹结果框 `.el-dialog.dialog_small.info_message`：「成功X条 失败Y条 + 失败订单号/原因」，关闭按钮文本「关 闭」。失败常见=所选仓库无库存。成功的单从【待处理】移到【三方仓】。 46 - orderShip 落地页默认就是【待处理】视图；`text=待处理` 会匹配到标题 span（无害 no-op）。订单表在主 frame(frame0=orderShip/index.html)，无需切 iframe；frame1-4 是 transition.html 预加载空 iframe。 47 - 之前抓的 erp_orderShip.html(2.9MB) 里 el-table__row/el-pagination 计数全是内联 JS/CSS 字符串，非真实 DOM，别用 raw grep 数元素。 48 49 **已完成**：操作手册；automation 骨架；**ERP 第一步「物流下单」DRY_RUN 全程验证通过（2026-07-08：会话有效→待处理12条→全选13→定位工具栏物流下单按钮，DRY 未真点）**。诊断脚本：capture/erp_probe_daichuli.py、erp_dump_grid.py、erp_test_selectall.py。 50 **物流下单真跑已完成（2026-07-08）**：真实点击成功，成功15条/失败1条(P2AA6TCD61046 无库存)，待处理16→1、三方仓19→34。erp.py 已修为真实点击。config.DRY_RUN 已改回 True。 51 52 **WMS 第二步真跑已完成（2026-07-08，黑猫JMCAT）**：ERP物流下单后订单同步到 WMS「一件代发>平台订单/未发货」。实测 6 单 → 全选 → 批量修改快递方=RM → 批量发货 →「预发货成功」→ 未发货 6→0。已复刻视频到 1:24。 53 **WMS 关键选择器/坑（实测）**：Element UI（el-table，非 vxe），平台订单页可直连 `orderInfo/page/orderInfo.html`（无需切 iframe）。 54 - 未发货数：读 `.el-pagination__total`「共N条」；`.el-table__row` 因固定列翻倍(6单=12行)，别直接数。 55 - 全选 `.el-table__header .el-checkbox`（elementhandle.click 即可，Element UI 不像 ERP-vxe 需防 JS click）。必须先勾选再点「批量修改快递方」，否则弹错框(下单确认)。 56 - 批量修改快递方：页面有多个隐藏 el-dialog，**必须 `.el-dialog:visible` 限定**！可见弹窗标题「快递信息修改」，内含快递方 el-select(选项 DPD/RM/EH/FEDEX)，确认按钮=可见弹窗内 `button.el-button--primary`。 57 - 改快递方确认后弹 Tip「成功」会挡住批量发货 → 先 close_tips 关掉；列表刷新丢勾选 → 发货前重新全选。 58 - 批量发货：可能二次确认，最终弹 Tip「预发货成功」；成功单离开未发货列表。Tip 容器 `.el-message-box__wrapper`，按钮文本「ok」。 59 执行脚本 capture/wms_ship_rm.py；wms.py 已按以上修正。 60 61 **按渠道编排重构已完成（2026-07-08）**：run_shipping.py 改为遍历 rules.CHANNEL_ORDER 逐渠道闭环（ERP该渠道物流下单→WMS对应账号按快递方优先级重试发货→失败留存）。各组件均已单独验证： 62 - `erp.filter_by_channel` 修好（实测各渠道正确筛出：BLACKCAT-RM=1、昇新-RM=4、昇新-DPD=2）。触发=`input[placeholder*='渠道']`；选项=`span.main_label`（**精确**匹配文本，别包含匹配——订单行物流信息列也含渠道文字会误点）；弹层有搜索框(常隐藏别依赖)+全选+取消/确定，确定=`.el-popper:visible button:has-text('确定')`。 63 - `erp.open_order_ship` 已加 `dismiss_alert_modal`（关落地弹的「订单异常提醒」，点 稍后处理/关闭）。 64 - `erp.place_logistics_orders` 返回 {count,success,fail,fail_orders}，`parse_result_text` 从结果框抽失败订单号(正则 `P[0-9A-Z]{9,15}`)。 65 - `wms.process_shop(page,account)` 返回 {before,left,left_orders}，试完所有快递方仍未发货的订单号记录返回。 66 - `core.log` 对 gbk 控制台健壮（emoji 用 replace 兜底，不再 UnicodeEncodeError）。 67 - 失败订单写 `logs/failures_YYYYMMDD.txt` + 日志提醒。 68 69 **⚠️ ERP 会话 TTL 很短(~10分钟)**：sellfox 手动登录后约 10 分钟就失效，别把窗口耗在分步探针上；真跑前先 `python capture/erp_manual_login.py` 登录、然后立刻 `python run_shipping.py` 一把跑完。 70 71 **完整 DRY 端到端已跑通（2026-07-08 16:43）**：run_shipping.py 一把跑完 5 渠道，筛选/映射/登账号/空渠道跳过/失败留存全部正确（BLACKCAT-RM=1→黑猫、昇新-RM=4/昇新-DPD=2→金猫）。 72 73 **订单状态更新（获取跟踪号）自动化已完成（2026-07-08，视频4:52后）**：`erp.update_order_status(page)` + `status_update_loop.py`（每10分钟定时）。**不分渠道（全部渠道）**、只拉取状态不发货、DRY_RUN 也执行（只读性质）。 74 - 路径：ERP orderShip → **三方仓**(左侧nav) → 顶部子标签 **待更新** → **先全选(vxe表头框，按钮无选中时禁用！)** → 工具栏 **手动更新** → 弹提示框「100% 状态：获取完成 详情：共N个包裹，已获取X个，Y个获取失败」→ 关闭(按钮文本「关 闭」)。 75 - 三方仓顶部子标签：成功/失败/获取中/待更新/异常件。手动更新只在【待更新】子标签工具栏出现。 76 - content.content: 1 # -*- coding: utf-8 -*- 2 """ 3 ERP（赛狐 Sellfox）操作：订单 > 订单处理（订单发货） 4 === 第一步：物流下单（对应视频前 50 多秒）=== 5 在【待处理】视图，(可选)按渠道筛选 -> 全选订单 -> 点击【物流下单】把订单投入海外仓 6 -> 读取结果弹窗「成功X 失败Y」(失败常见：所选仓库库存不足)。 7 DRY_RUN=True 时：完成 切视图/筛选/全选/统计，但【不】点击"物流下单"，只记录将处理的订单数。 8 9 其它阶段(审核通过/确认发货/获取跟踪单号)见后续，同样受 DRY_RUN 保护。 10 """ 11 import re, time 12 import config, core 13 from core import log 14 15 16 # ---------------- 打开与导航 ---------------- 17 def open_order_ship(page): 18 core.safe_goto(page, config.ERP_URL) 19 for _ in range(30): 20 time.sleep(1) 21 if page.query_selector(".el-table") or page.query_selector("text=订单处理"): 22 break 23 time.sleep(2) 24 dismiss_alert_modal(page) 25 26 27 def dismiss_alert_modal(page): 28 """关闭落地时弹出的「订单异常提醒」等拦截弹窗（点 稍后处理/关闭），避免挡住后续操作。""" 29 for _ in range(3): 30 closed = False 31 for t in ["稍后处理", "关 闭", "关闭", "我知道了", "取 消", "取消"]: 32 b = page.query_selector(f".el-dialog:visible button:has-text('{t}'), .el-message-box:visible button:has-text('{t}')") 33 if b and b.is_visible(): 34 try: 35 b.click(); closed = True; time.sleep(1) 36 except Exception: 37 pass 38 break 39 if not closed: 40 break 41 42 43 def dismiss_notifications(page): 44 """清掉右上角 el-notification toast（如"下载中心"通知）。它是浮层，会盖在筛选框/按钮上 45 拦截 Playwright 点击（intercepts pointer events），直接从 DOM 移除最稳。""" 46 try: 47 page.evaluate("() => document.querySelectorAll('.el-notification').forEach(e => e.remove())") 48 except Exception: 49 pass 50 51 52 def goto_view(page, name): 53 """点击左侧导航切换视图，如 '待处理' / '待审核'。""" 54 try: 55 page.click(f"text={name}", timeout=6000) 56 time.sleep(3) 57 log(f"[ERP] 切换到视图：{name}") 58 return True 59 except Exception as e: 60 log(f"[ERP] 切换视图 {name} 失败: {e}") 61 return False 62 63 64 def report_counts(page): 65 labels = ["待审核", "待处理", "自营仓库", "三方仓", "有货", "缺货", "已发货", "已搁置", "异常处理"] 66 result = {} 67 for lb in labels: 68 try: 69 el = page.query_selector(f"text={lb}") 70 num = None 71 if el: 72 parent = el.evaluate_handle("e=>e.parentElement") 73 txt = page.evaluate("e=>e.innerText", parent) 74 m = re.findall(r"\d+", txt or "") 75 num = m[-1] if m else None 76 result[lb] = num 77 except Exception: 78 result[lb] = None 79 log(f"[ERP] 阶段统计: {result}") 80 return result 81 82 83 # ---------------- 渠道筛选（可选） ---------------- 84 def filter_by_channel(page, channel_keyword): 85 """在「全部渠道」多选弹层里选中 == channel_keyword 的渠道并确定。channel_keyword=None 不筛选。 86 实测：触发控件 input[placeholder*='渠道']；渠道选项是 span.main_label（精确匹配文本， 87 别用包含匹配——订单行 物流信息列 也含渠道文字会误点）；弹层有 取消/确定。""" 88 if not channel_keyword: 89 return True 90 try: 91 dismiss_notifications(page) # 先清右上角通知浮层，否则会拦截点击 92 page.click("input[placeholder*='渠道']", timeout=5000, force=True) 93 time.sleep(1.2) 94 picked = False 95 for el in page.query_selector_all("span.main_label"): 96 try: 97 if el.is_visible() and (el.inner_text() or "").strip() == channel_keyword: 98 el.click(); picked = True 99 log(f"[ERP] 渠道选中: {channel_keyword}") 100 break 101 except Exception: 102 continue 103 if not picked: 104 log(f"[ERP] 未找到渠道选项: {channel_keyword}") 105 try: page.keyboard.press("Escape") 106 except Exception: pass 107 return False 108 time.sleep(0.5) 109 # 确定（限可见弹层） 110 for t in ["确定", "确认"]: 111 b = page.query_selector(f".el-popper:visible button:has-text('{t}')") 112 if not (b and b.is_visible()): 113 b = page.query_selector(f"button:has-text('{t}'):visible") 114 if b and b.is_visible(): 115 b.click(); break 116 time.sleep(2.5) 117 return True 118 except Exception as e: 119 log(f"[ERP] 渠道筛选失败: {e}") 120 return False 121 122 123 # ---------------- 选择与下单 ---------------- 124 def _find_toolbar_button(page, text): 125 """定位工具栏批量按钮：文本恰为 text、不在 vxe 表格行内、可见、y 最靠上的那个。 126 返回 elementhandle（用于 Playwright 真实点击）。""" 127 target, ty = None, None 128 for h in page.query_selector_all("button, .el-button, .base_button_comp, .myj-btn, [class*=btn]"): 129 try: 130 if (h.inner_text() or "").replace("　", " ").replace(" ", "").strip() != text: 131 continue 132 if h.evaluate("e=>!!e.closest('.vxe-body--row')"): 133 continue 134 if not h.is_visible(): 135 continue 136 bb = h.bounding_box() 137 if not bb: 138 continue 139 if target is None or bb["y"] < ty: 140 target, ty = h, bb["y"] 141 except Exception: 142 continue 143 return target 144 145 146 147 def count_orders(page): 148 """读取订单总数。订单表是 vxe-table，自定义分页把总数拆成 149 `共 N 条`，故读 .total_style（页面可能有多个分页实例，取最大值）。 150 数据是异步加载的：轮询等待 total>0 或超时。""" 151 for _ in range(5): # 最多 5s：有单基本秒出，0 单最多等 5s 判空（原 20s） 152 try: 153 n = page.evaluate( 154 "() => { const a=[...document.querySelectorAll('.total_style')]" 155 ".map(e=>parseInt((e.innerText||'0').replace(/\\D/g,''),10))" 156 ".filter(x=>!isNaN(x)); return a.length? Math.max(...a):0; }" 157 ) 158 if n and n > 0: 159 return int(n) 160 except Exception: 161 pass 162 time.sleep(1) 163 # 兜底：按去重后的 vxe 行数（固定列会翻倍，用逻辑行组 .parentRowGroup） 164 try: 165 return page.evaluate("() => document.querySelectorAll('.parentRowGroup').length") 166 except Exception: 167 return 0 168 169 170 def select_all(page): 171 """点击 vxe-table 表头全选框，并校验确有行被勾选。""" 172 th = page.query_selector(".vxe-header--column.col--checkbox .vxe-cell--checkbox") 173 if not th: 174 log("[ERP] 未找到 vxe 表头全选框"); return False 175 if "is--disabled" in (th.get_attribute("class") or ""): 176 log("[ERP] 表头全选框禁用（可能无数据）"); return False 177 try: 178 th.click(); time.sleep(1.5) 179 except Exception as e: 180 log(f"[ERP] 全选点击失败: {e}"); return False 181 checked = page.evaluate( 182 "() => document.querySelectorAll('.vxe-body--row.row--checked, .vxe-cell--checkbox.is--checked').length" 183 ) 184 if not checked: 185 log("[ERP] 全选后未检测到勾选行"); return False 186 log(f"[ERP] 已全选，勾选标记数≈{checked}") 187 return True 188 189 190 def parse_result_text(txt): 191 """从结果框文本解析 成功/失败数 与失败订单号。返回 {success,fail,fail_orders,text}。""" 192 if not txt: 193 return {"success": None, "fail": None, "fail_orders": [], "text": ""} 194 ms = re.search(r"成功[:：]?\s*(\d+)", txt) 195 mf = re.search(r"失败[:：]?\s*(\d+)", txt) 196 # 订单/包裹号形如 P2AC6TCD61425（P + 十余位字母数字） 197 orders = re.findall(r"\bP[0-9A-Z]{9,15}\b", txt) 198 # 去掉可能混入的表头等，保留失败区（有失败时才收集） 199 return { 200 "success": int(ms.group(1)) if ms else None, 201 "fail": int(mf.group(1)) if mf else None, 202 "fail_orders": list(dict.fromkeys(orders)), 203 "text": txt, 204 } 205 206 207 def read_result_dialog(page): 208 """读取物流下单后的结果弹窗文本（成功X 失败Y + 原因），解析后关闭。返回 parse 字典。""" 209 txt = None 210 for _ in range(30): 211 dlg = page.query_selector(".el-dialog__wrapper:not([style*='display: none']) .el-dialog, .el-message-box") 212 if dlg: 213 try: txt = (dlg.inner_text() or "").strip() 214 except Exception: pass 215 break 216 time.sleep(1) 217 if txt: 218 log("[ERP] 物流下单结果:\n" + txt[:800]) 219 # 关闭：只在【可见】弹窗内找按钮，且 click 用短超时。 220 # 旧写法 query_selector 不限定可见弹窗、b.click() 用默认 30 秒超时——命中隐藏 el-dialog 221 # 里的同名按钮就会干等满 30 秒，几个候选累计 ~90–120 秒（2026-07-10 日志：全成功也卡 222 # 124s≈4×30、有失败卡 91s≈3×30），这才是“下单后卡在结果页很久”的真因。 223 closed = False 224 for t in ["关 闭", "关闭", "确 定", "确定", "知道了", "ok"]: 225 b = page.query_selector( 226 f".el-dialog__wrapper:not([style*='display: none']) button:has-text('{t}'), " 227 f".el-message-box__wrapper:not([style*='display: none']) button:has-text('{t}')") 228 if b and b.is_visible(): 229 try: 230 b.click(timeout=3000); closed = True; break 231 except Exception: 232 pass 233 if not closed: 234 try: page.keyboard.press("Escape") 235 except Exception: pass 236 time.sleep(1) 237 return parse_result_text(txt) 238 239 240 def place_logistics_orders(page, channel_keyword=None): 241 """ 242 第一步核心：待处理视图 -> (可选渠道筛选) -> 全选 -> 物流下单 -> 读结果。 243 DRY_RUN 下不点击"物流下单"。 244 """ 245 open_order_ship(page) 246 if not goto_view(page, "待处理"): 247 return 248 # 安全底线：指定了渠道就必须筛选成功，否则会对未筛选的全量订单下单（跨渠道误发）。 249 if channel_keyword and not filter_by_channel(page, channel_keyword): 250 log(f"[ERP] 渠道筛选未成功({channel_keyword})，为避免全量误下单，跳过本渠道") 251 core.log.event("物流下单", channel=channel_keyword, error="渠道筛选失败跳过", dry_run=config.DRY_RUN) 252 return {"count": 0, "error": "渠道筛选失败", "channel_filter_failed": True} 253 n = count_orders(page) 254 log(f"[ERP] 待处理订单 共 {n} 条" + (f"（渠道过滤: {channel_keyword}）" if channel_keyword else "")) 255 if n == 0: 256 log("[ERP] 无待处理订单"); return {"count": 0, "success": 0, "fail": 0, "fail_orders": []} 257 258 if not select_all(page): 259 log("[ERP] 全选失败，终止物流下单"); return {"count": n, "error": "全选失败"} 260 261 if config.DRY_RUN: 262 log(f"[ERP][DRY] 将点击【物流下单】处理 {n} 条订单（已跳过实际点击）") 263 core.log.event("物流下单", channel=channel_keyword, count=n, dry_run=True) 264 return {"count": n, "dry_run": True} 265 266 # 点"物流下单"。行内也有同名按钮，必须点工具栏批量按钮。 267 # 关键：必须用 Playwright 真实点击(elementhandle.click)，JS 合成 click 不触发 Vue 事件！ 268 btn = _find_toolbar_button(page, "物流下单") 269 if not btn: 270 log("[ERP] 未定位到工具栏【物流下单】按钮"); return {"count": n, "error": "未找到物流下单按钮"} 271 try: 272 btn.click() 273 log(f"[ERP] 已点击工具栏【物流下单】，处理 {n} 条") 274 except Exception as e: 275 log(f"[ERP] 点击物流下单失败: {e}"); return {"count": n, "error": str(e)} 276 time.sleep(3) 277 r = read_result_dialog(page) 278 if r.get("fail"): 279 log(f"[ERP] ⚠️ 物流下单失败 {r['fail']} 单：{r['fail_orders']}") 280 core.log.event("物流下单", channel=channel_keyword, count=n, 281 success=r.get("success"), fail=r.get("fail"), 282 fail_orders=r.get("fail_orders", []), dry_run=False) 283 return {"count": n, "success": r.get("success"), "fail": r.get("fail"), 284 "fail_orders": r.get("fail_orders", []), "result_text": r.get("text")} 285 286 287 # ---------------- 订单状态更新（三方仓>待更新>手动更新，获取跟踪号）---------------- 288 def _toolbar_btn_coord(page, text): 289 """返回工具栏(非行内)中 去空白后文本==text 的按钮中心坐标 {x,y}（取最内层）。无则 None。""" 290 return page.evaluate(r"""(text) => { 291 const norm = s => (s||'').replace(/\s+/g,''); 292 let best=null; 293 document.querySelectorAll('button, .el-button, .base_button_comp, [class*=btn]').forEach(e=>{ 294 if(e.offsetParent===null) return; 295 if(norm(e.innerText)!==text) return; 296 if(e.closest('.vxe-body--row')) return; // 排除行内同名按钮 297 const r=e.getBoundingClientRect(); 298 const desc=e.querySelectorAll('*').length; 299 if(!best || desc 待更新 子标签 -> 工具栏【手动更新】-> 拉取跟踪号 -> 307 读「获取完成 共N包裹 已获取X 失败Y」-> 关闭。不分渠道。返回 {total,got,fail,text}。 308 此操作只拉取/更新状态，不发货，DRY_RUN 也执行（属只读性质的状态同步）。""" 309 open_order_ship(page) 310 # 三方仓 311 try: 312 page.click("text=三方仓", timeout=6000); time.sleep(3) 313 except Exception as e: 314 log(f"[ERP] 进三方仓失败: {e}"); return {"error": "进三方仓失败"} 315 # 待更新 子标签 316 try: 317 page.click("text=待更新", timeout=6000); time.sleep(2.5) 318 except Exception as e: 319 log(f"[ERP] 点待更新子标签失败: {e}"); return {"error": "待更新子标签失败"} 320 321 n = count_orders(page) 322 if not n: 323 log("[ERP] 待更新 0 条，无需状态更新") 324 return {"total": 0, "got": 0, "fail": 0, "text": "待更新为空"} 325 # 手动更新按钮无选中时禁用 -> 先全选（vxe 表头框） 326 if not select_all(page): 327 log("[ERP] 待更新全选失败"); return {"error": "待更新全选失败"} 328 329 loc = _toolbar_btn_coord(page, "手动更新") 330 if not loc: 331 log("[ERP] 未找到【手动更新】按钮") 332 return {"total": n, "got": 0, "fail": 0, "text": "无手动更新按钮"} 333 page.mouse.click(loc["x"], loc["y"]) 334 log(f"[ERP] 已全选 {n} 条并点【手动更新】，拉取跟踪号中…") 335 336 # 轮询提示框直到 获取完成/100% 337 final = None 338 for _ in range(60): 339 time.sleep(1) 340 txt = page.evaluate(r"""() => { 341 const d=[...document.querySelectorAll('.el-dialog, .el-message-box')].find(e=>e.offsetParent!==null); 342 return d? (d.innerText||'').trim() : null; 343 }""") 344 if txt: 345 final = txt 346 if ("获取完成" in txt) or ("100%" in txt): 347 break 348 # 解析 共N 已获取X 失败Y 349 res = {"total": None, "got": None, "fail": None, "text": final} 350 if final: 351 mt = re.search(r"共\s*(\d+)\s*个?包裹", final) 352 mg = re.search(r"已获取\s*(\d+)", final) 353 mf = re.search(r"(\d+)\s*个?获取失败", final) 354 res["total"] = int(mt.group(1)) if mt else None 355 res["got"] = int(mg.group(1)) if mg else None 356 res["fail"] = int(mf.group(1)) if mf else None 357 log(f"[ERP] 状态更新结果: 共{res['total']} 已获取{res['got']} 失败{res['fail']}") 358 core.log.event("获取跟踪号", total=res.get("total"), got=res.get("got"), fail=res.get("fail")) 359 # 关闭提示框 360 for t in ["关闭", "关 闭", "确定", "确 定", "ok", "OK"]: 361 b = page.query_selector(f".el-dialog:visible button:has-text('{t}'), .el-message-box:visible button:has-text('{t}')") 362 if b and b.is_visible(): 363 try: b.click() 364 except Exception: pass 365 break 366 time.sleep(1) 367 return res 368 369 370 # ---------------- 其它阶段（后续，DRY_RUN 保护） ---------------- 371 def get_tracking(page): 372 """[已废弃] 手册 v1.0 初版把「获取跟踪单号」理解为 待发货列表>更多>获取跟踪单号， 373 但实际落地时确认真实路径是 三方仓>待更新>手动更新（见 update_order_status，已实测验证）。 374 保留此函数名做兼容，直接转发到已验证实现，避免再用旧 el-table 假设的错误路径。""" 375 log("[ERP] get_tracking 已并入 update_order_status（三方仓>待更新>手动更新），转发调用。") 376 return update_order_status(page) 377 378 379 def confirm_shipping(page, channel_keyword=None): 380 """[已废弃/等同] 业务确认（2026-07-08）：ERP「确认发货」与「物流下单」是同一步操作， 381 都在【待处理】视图、勾选后触发、结果框「成功X/失败Y（失败=库存不足）」。 382 故不再单列实现，直接转发到已实测验证的 place_logistics_orders，避免重复扣库存/提交平台。""" 383 log("[ERP] confirm_shipping 与 place_logistics_orders 为同一步，转发调用。") 384 return place_logistics_orders(page, channel_keyword=channel_keyword) 385

1	# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
2	"""
3	WMS（海外仓）操作：一件代发 > 平台订单
4	流程：筛选未发货 -> 全选 -> 批量修改快递方(= 该渠道对应的那一个快递方) -> 批量发货。
5	      快递方由 ERP 下单渠道末段决定(一一对应，用户规则 2026-07-09)，只发一次；
6	      失败的留在"未发货"即留存提醒，不换别的快递方。
7	DRY_RUN=True 时不真正点击"确认/批量发货"，只记录将要执行的动作。
8	"""
9	import time
10	import config, core
11	from core import log, ORDERINFO_WMS
12	from rules import ALL_COURIERS
13	
14	
15	def open_platform_orders(page):
16	    core.safe_goto(page, ORDERINFO_WMS)
17	    time.sleep(4)
18	
19	
20	def count_rows(page):
21	    """未发货订单数。优先读分页 '共 N 条'（el-table 固定列会使 .el-table__row 翻倍，不能直接数行）。"""
22	    import re
23	    el = page.query_selector(".el-pagination__total")
24	    if el:
25	        m = re.findall(r"\d+", el.inner_text() or "")
26	        if m:
27	            return int(m[0])
28	    rows = page.query_selector_all(".el-table__row")
29	    return len(rows) // 2 if rows else 0
30	
31	
32	def close_tips(page, rounds=4):
33	    """关闭所有可见 el-message-box / Tip（点 ok/确定/关闭），返回文本列表。"""
34	    texts = []
35	    for _ in range(rounds):
36	        box = page.query_selector(".el-message-box__wrapper:visible .el-message-box")
37	        if not box:
38	            break
39	        try:
40	            texts.append((box.inner_text() or "").strip()[:120])
41	        except Exception:
42	            pass
43	        done = False
44	        for t in ["ok", "OK", "确定", "确认", "关闭", "知道了"]:
45	            b = page.query_selector(f".el-message-box__wrapper:visible button:has-text('{t}')")
46	            if b and b.is_visible():
47	                try: b.click(); done = True
48	                except Exception: pass
49	                break
50	        if not done:
51	            try: page.keyboard.press("Escape")
52	            except Exception: pass
53	        time.sleep(1)
54	    return texts
55	
56	
57	def ensure_unshipped_filter(page):
58	    """确保状态筛选为'未发货'并查询。页面默认即为未发货，这里点一次查询刷新。"""
59	    try:
60	        page.click("button:has-text('查询')", timeout=5000)
61	        time.sleep(3)
62	    except Exception as e:
63	        log(f"[WMS] 点击查询失败: {e}")
64	
65	
66	def select_all(page):
67	    """勾选表头全选框。无数据时该框禁用，返回 False。"""
68	    header_cb = page.query_selector(".el-table__header-wrapper .el-checkbox, .el-table__header .el-checkbox")
69	    if not header_cb:
70	        return False
71	    cls = header_cb.get_attribute("class") or ""
72	    if "is-disabled" in cls:
73	        return False
74	    try:
75	        header_cb.click()
76	        time.sleep(1)
77	        return True
78	    except Exception as e:
79	        log(f"[WMS] 全选失败: {e}")
80	        return False
81	
82	
83	def set_courier(page, courier):
84	    """打开'批量修改快递方'弹窗，选择 courier，确认。DRY_RUN 下不点确认。"""
85	    try:
86	        page.click("button:has-text('批量修改快递方')", timeout=6000)
87	    except Exception as e:
88	        log(f"[WMS] 打开'批量修改快递方'失败: {e}")
89	        return False
90	    time.sleep(1.5)
91	    # 可见弹窗(:visible)内的 快递方 下拉（页面存在多个隐藏 el-dialog，必须限定可见）
92	    try:
93	        page.click(".el-dialog:visible .el-select", timeout=4000)
94	        time.sleep(1)
95	        opt = None
96	        for el in page.query_selector_all(".el-select-dropdown__item"):
97	            if el.is_visible() and (el.inner_text() or "").strip() == courier:
98	                opt = el; break
99	        if not opt:
100	            log(f"[WMS] 未找到快递方选项 {courier}")
101	            _close_dialog(page)
102	            return False
103	        opt.click()
104	        time.sleep(0.5)
105	    except Exception as e:
106	        log(f"[WMS] 选择快递方 {courier} 失败: {e}")
107	        _close_dialog(page)
108	        return False
109	
110	    if config.DRY_RUN:
111	        log(f"[WMS][DRY] 将设置快递方 = {courier}（跳过'确认'）")
112	        _close_dialog(page)
113	        return True
114	    try:
115	        # 确认按钮：可见弹窗内的 primary 按钮（文本'确认'，与'取消'区分）
116	        ok = page.query_selector(".el-dialog:visible button.el-button--primary")
117	        if not ok:
118	            for b in page.query_selector_all(".el-dialog:visible button"):
119	                if (b.inner_text() or "").replace(" ", "") in ("确认", "确定"):
120	                    ok = b; break
121	        if not ok:
122	            log("[WMS] 未找到可见确认按钮"); return False
123	        ok.click()
124	        time.sleep(2)
125	        tips = close_tips(page)   # 关掉"成功"Tip，否则挡住后续批量发货
126	        log(f"[WMS] 已设置快递方 = {courier}  Tip={tips}")
127	        return True
128	    except Exception as e:
129	        log(f"[WMS] 确认快递方失败: {e}")
130	        return False
131	
132	
133	def _close_dialog(page):
134	    """关闭当前可见的 el-dialog（点 取消 / 右上角 X），兜底 Escape。
135	    必须限定 :visible —— 页面存在多个隐藏 el-dialog，不限定会点到隐藏弹窗、可见弹窗关不掉，
136	    残留弹窗会拦截后续点击（2026-07-10 DRY 演练实测：全选被 el-dialog__wrapper 拦截超时）。"""
137	    for sel in (".el-dialog:visible button:has-text('取 消')",
138	                ".el-dialog:visible button:has-text('取消')",
139	                ".el-dialog:visible .el-dialog__headerbtn"):
140	        try:
141	            b = page.query_selector(sel)
142	            if b and b.is_visible():
143	                b.click(); time.sleep(0.6); return
144	        except Exception:
145	            pass
146	    try:
147	        page.keyboard.press("Escape")
148	    except Exception:
149	        pass
150	    time.sleep(0.6)
151	
152	
153	def batch_ship(page):
154	    """点击'批量发货'，处理'预发货成功'提示。DRY_RUN 下不执行。"""
155	    if config.DRY_RUN:
156	        log("[WMS][DRY] 将点击'批量发货'（已跳过）")
157	        return True
158	    try:
159	        page.click("button:has-text('批量发货')", timeout=6000)
160	        time.sleep(2)
161	        # 可能的二次确认（限可见弹窗）
162	        for t in ["确定", "确认", "ok", "OK"]:
163	            b = page.query_selector(f".el-message-box__wrapper:visible button:has-text('{t}'), .el-dialog:visible button:has-text('{t}')")
164	            if b and b.is_visible():
165	                try: b.click(); time.sleep(1.5)
166	                except Exception: pass
167	                break
168	        time.sleep(2)
169	        tips = close_tips(page)   # 捕获并关闭 'Tip: 预发货成功'
170	        ok = any("预发货成功" in t or "成功" in t for t in tips)
171	        log(f"[WMS] 已执行批量发货  结果Tip={tips}")
172	        return ok if tips else True
173	    except Exception as e:
174	        log(f"[WMS] 批量发货失败: {e}")
175	        return False
176	
177	
178	def read_order_numbers(page):
179	    """读当前未发货列表的平台订单号（去重）。订单号形如 P2AC6TCD61443。"""
180	    try:
181	        nums = page.evaluate(r"""() => {
182	            const s=new Set();
183	            document.querySelectorAll('.el-table__row').forEach(r=>{
184	                const m=(r.innerText||'').match(/P[0-9A-Z]{9,15}/g); if(m) m.forEach(x=>s.add(x));
185	            });
186	            return [...s];
187	        }""")
188	        return nums or []
189	    except Exception:
190	        return []
191	
192	
193	def ship_shop(wms_browser, account, courier):
194	    """给单个店铺发货：用【独立干净 WMS context】登录 + process_shop，用完即关。
195	    独立 context 是根治「多账号共用一个 context 时，第二个账号登录读到前一个账号会话」
196	    的关键（实测 2026-07-10：黑猫先登→金猫后登，金猫会读到黑猫的空列表=漏发）。
197	    wms_browser: 独立于 ERP 持久 context 的 browser（run_shipping/shipping_loop 里 launch）。
198	    返回 process_shop 的结果 dict。"""
199	    wctx = wms_browser.new_context(ignore_https_errors=True)
200	    wpage = wctx.new_page()
201	    try:
202	        return process_shop(wpage, account, courier)
203	    finally:
204	        try:
205	            wctx.close()
206	        except Exception:
207	            pass
208	
209	
210	def process_shop(page, account, courier, already_logged_in=False):
211	    """处理单个店铺：用【该渠道对应的单一快递方 courier】改快递方 + 批量发货一次。
212	    失败的单留在'未发货'即留存（不换别的快递方、不轮转，用户规则 2026-07-09）。
213	    返回 {shop, courier, before, left, left_orders}。"""
214	    log(f"[WMS] === 处理店铺 {account['shop']}（{account['login']}），本渠道快递方 = {courier} ===")
215	    if not courier:
216	        log(f"[WMS] ⚠️ {account['shop']} 未解析出快递方，跳过发货（留存交上层处理）")
217	        return {"shop": account["shop"], "courier": "", "error": "无快递方", "left_orders": []}
218	    if not already_logged_in and not core.wms_login(page, account):
219	        log(f"[WMS] {account['shop']} 登录失败，跳过")
220	        return {"shop": account["shop"], "courier": courier, "error": "登录失败", "left_orders": []}
221	    open_platform_orders(page)
222	    ensure_unshipped_filter(page)
223	
224	    total_before = count_rows(page)
225	    log(f"[WMS] {account['shop']} 未发货订单 ≈ {total_before} 条")
226	    if total_before == 0:
227	        log(f"[WMS] {account['shop']} 无未发货订单")
228	        return {"shop": account["shop"], "courier": courier, "before": 0, "left": 0, "left_orders": []}
229	
230	    limit = config.MAX_ORDERS_PER_RUN
231	    if limit and total_before > limit:
232	        log(f"[WMS][安全] 未发货 {total_before} > 单次上限 {limit}，建议调大 MAX_ORDERS_PER_RUN 或分批。")
233	
234	    # 单一快递方：全选 -> 改成 courier -> 重新全选（改后列表刷新丢勾选） -> 批量发货。只一次，不轮转。
235	    log(f"[WMS] 用快递方 [{courier}] 处理 {total_before} 条")
236	    if not select_all(page):
237	        log("[WMS] 无法全选（可能无数据/禁用），本渠道未发货")
238	    elif not set_courier(page, courier):
239	        log(f"[WMS] 改快递方 {courier} 未成功，本渠道未发货")
240	    elif not select_all(page):
241	        log("[WMS] 改快递方后重新全选失败，本渠道未发货")
242	    else:
243	        batch_ship(page)
244	        time.sleep(2)
245	
246	    open_platform_orders(page)
247	    ensure_unshipped_filter(page)
248	    left = count_rows(page)
249	    left_orders = read_order_numbers(page) if left else []
250	    dry = "（DRY_RUN 未真正发货）" if config.DRY_RUN else ""
251	    log(f"[WMS] {account['shop']} 处理完成，仍未发货 ≈ {left} 条{dry}")
252	    if left and not config.DRY_RUN:
253	        log(f"[WMS] ⚠️ {account['shop']} 用 {courier} 发货后仍未发货（留存，不换快递方）：{left_orders}")
254	    core.log.event("WMS发货汇总", shop=account["shop"], account=account["login"], courier=courier,
255	                   before=total_before, shipped=max(0, total_before - left),
256	                   left=left, left_orders=left_orders)
257	    return {"shop": account["shop"], "courier": courier, "before": total_before,
258	            "left": left, "left_orders": left_orders}

56	    }""")

59	def dump_control(page):
60	    """dump 含'偏远'的筛选控件结构。"""
61	    return page.evaluate(r"""() => {
62	      const out=[];
63	      document.querySelectorAll('.el-select, .el-input').forEach(g=>{
64	        const inp=g.querySelector('input');
65	        if(!inp) return;
66	        const ph=inp.getAttribute('placeholder')||'';
67	        if(ph.includes('偏远')) out.push({placeholder: ph, value: inp.value||'', cls: g.className});
68	      });
69	      return out;
70	    }""")
71	
72	
73	def main():
74	    with sync_playwright() as p:
75	        browser = p.chromium.launch(headless=True, args=["--no-sandbox"])
76	        ctx = browser.new_context(ignore_https_errors=True)
77	        page = ctx.new_page()
78	        try:
79	            core.wms_login(page, JMSM)
80	            core.safe_goto(page, ORDERINFO_WMS); time.sleep(4)
81	            query(page)
82	            w(f"未发货(初始) total = {total(page)}")
83	            w(f"偏远筛选控件 = {dump_control(page)}")
84	
85	            # 打开「是否偏远地区」下拉，dump 选项
86	            inp = page.query_selector("input[placeholder*='偏远']")
87	            w(f"input[placeholder*='偏远'] 命中 = {bool(inp)}")
88	            if inp:
89	                inp.click(); time.sleep(1.2)
90	                items = [ (o.inner_text() or "").strip() for o in page.query_selector_all(".el-select-dropdown__item") if o.is_visible() ]
91	                w(f"下拉可见选项 = {items}")
92	                # 选「否」

95	                    if o.is_visible() and (o.inner_text() or "").strip() == "否":
96	                        o.click(); picked = True; break

103	            ctx.close(); browser.close()

ERP 两张截图很关键。我看到了 `筛选模板` 按钮位置（image1）和点开后的弹层（image2）：左侧「模板名称」列有**未取消等待发货**（红框）和**单品单件未取消待发货**两项，右侧悬停显示模板详情=退款订单:否/换货订单:否/申请取消:否/禁止处理:否。

⚠️**关键发现**：image1 应用模板前是「所有包裹**(2)**」，image2 点了模板后变成「所有包裹**(5)**」，且下方筛选 chip 只剩 退款/换货/申请取消/禁止处理:否，**渠道 chip 不见了** → 高度怀疑「选模板会重置渠道筛选」。这正是记忆里标记的待实测风险，必须真登 ERP 验证顺序。

1	# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
2	"""
3	WMS 发货编排自测（新规则，2026-07-09）：验证 process_shop「单一快递方一次发货」逻辑。
4	
5	新规则：一个渠道对应唯一快递方（渠道末段 -RM/-DPD/-EH），WMS 这批单只改成那一个快递方、
6	发一次；能发的发出，发不出的留在'未发货'即留存提醒——**不换别的快递方、不轮转**。
7	
8	这里用 mock 把 wms 模块里所有和浏览器交互的函数替换成纯内存假实现，只保留 process_shop 的
9	**编排逻辑**（全选/改快递方/发货一次、留存），从而不依赖真实系统验证正确性。
10	
11	运行：  python capture/wms_rotation_selftest.py
12	不连任何系统、不需要登录，纯逻辑自测。
13	"""
14	import os, sys
15	sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))))
16	
17	import config, core, wms
18	
19	
20	class FakePage:
21	    """占位 page，mock 里不真正用它。"""
22	    pass
23	
24	
25	class Scenario:
26	    """模拟 WMS 未发货列表状态：
27	    orders = {订单号: 该单能成功发货的快递方集合}
28	    batch_ship 时，当前设置的快递方若在某单的可发集合里，则该单发出（离开列表）。
29	    """
30	    def __init__(self, orders):
31	        self.orders = dict(orders)          # 剩余未发货
32	        self.current_courier = None
33	        self.selected = False
34	        self.courier_history = []           # 依次设置过的快递方（新规则下应至多 1 个）
35	        self.ship_rounds = 0
36	
37	    # ---- 下面这些替换 wms.* 与 core.wms_login ----
38	    def wms_login(self, page, account):
39	        return True
40	
41	    def open_platform_orders(self, page):
42	        self.selected = False
43	
44	    def ensure_unshipped_filter(self, page):
45	        pass
46	
47	    def count_rows(self, page):
48	        return len(self.orders)
49	
50	    def read_order_numbers(self, page):
51	        return list(self.orders.keys())
52	
53	    def select_all(self, page):
54	        if not self.orders:
55	            return False
56	        self.selected = True
57	        return True
58	
59	    def set_courier(self, page, courier):
60	        if not self.selected:
61	            return False
62	        self.current_courier = courier
63	        self.courier_history.append(courier)
64	        return True
65	
66	    def batch_ship(self, page):
67	        self.ship_rounds += 1
68	        shipped = [o for o, ok in self.orders.items()
69	                   if self.current_courier in ok]
70	        for o in shipped:
71	            del self.orders[o]
72	        self.selected = False
73	        return True
74	
75	
76	def install(scn):
77	    """把 scenario 的方法装到 wms / core 上，返回还原函数。"""
78	    saved = {
79	        "wms.open_platform_orders": wms.open_platform_orders,
80	        "wms.ensure_unshipped_filter": wms.ensure_unshipped_filter,
81	        "wms.count_rows": wms.count_rows,
82	        "wms.read_order_numbers": wms.read_order_numbers,
83	        "wms.select_all": wms.select_all,
84	        "wms.set_courier": wms.set_courier,
85	        "wms.batch_ship": wms.batch_ship,
86	        "core.wms_login": core.wms_login,
87	    }
88	    wms.open_platform_orders = scn.open_platform_orders
89	    wms.ensure_unshipped_filter = scn.ensure_unshipped_filter
90	    wms.count_rows = scn.count_rows
91	    wms.read_order_numbers = scn.read_order_numbers
92	    wms.select_all = scn.select_all
93	    wms.set_courier = scn.set_courier
94	    wms.batch_ship = scn.batch_ship
95	    core.wms_login = scn.wms_login
96	
97	    def restore():
98	        wms.open_platform_orders = saved["wms.open_platform_orders"]
99	        wms.ensure_unshipped_filter = saved["wms.ensure_unshipped_filter"]
100	        wms.count_rows = saved["wms.count_rows"]
101	        wms.read_order_numbers = saved["wms.read_order_numbers"]
102	        wms.select_all = saved["wms.select_all"]
103	        wms.set_courier = saved["wms.set_courier"]
104	        wms.batch_ship = saved["wms.batch_ship"]
105	        core.wms_login = saved["core.wms_login"]
106	    return restore
107	
108	
109	def run_case(name, account, courier, orders, expect_history, expect_left_orders):
110	    scn = Scenario(orders)
111	    restore = install(scn)
112	    try:
113	        res = wms.process_shop(FakePage(), account, courier)
114	    finally:
115	        restore()
116	
117	    left = sorted(res.get("left_orders") or [])
118	    ok_hist = scn.courier_history == expect_history
119	    ok_left = left == sorted(expect_left_orders)
120	    ok_rounds = scn.ship_rounds <= 1                      # 新规则：至多发一次
121	    ok = ok_hist and ok_left and ok_rounds and res.get("left", -1) == len(expect_left_orders)

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""
WMS 发货编排自测（新规则，2026-07-09）：验证 process_shop「单一快递方一次发货」逻辑。

新规则：一个渠道对应唯一快递方（渠道末段 -RM/-DPD/-EH），WMS 这批单只改成那一个快递方、
发一次；能发的发出，发不出的留在'未发货'即留存提醒——**不换别的快递方、不轮转**。

这里用 mock 把 wms 模块里所有和浏览器交互的函数替换成纯内存假实现，只保留 process_shop 的
**编排逻辑**（全选/改快递方/发货一次、留存），从而不依赖真实系统验证正确性。

运行：  python capture/wms_rotation_selftest.py
不连任何系统、不需要登录，纯逻辑自测。
"""
import os, sys
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))))

import config, core, wms


class FakePage:
    """占位 page，mock 里不真正用它。"""
    pass


class Scenario:
    """模拟 WMS 未发货列表状态：
    orders = {订单号: 该单能成功发货的快递方集合}
    batch_ship 时，当前设置的快递方若在某单的可发集合里，则该单发出（离开列表）。
    """
    def __init__(self, orders):
        self.orders = dict(orders)          # 剩余未发货
        self.current_courier = None
        self.selected = False
        self.courier_history = []           # 依次设置过的快递方（新规则下应至多 1 个）
        self.ship_rounds = 0

    # ---- 下面这些替换 wms.* 与 core.wms_login ----
    def wms_login(self, page, account):
        return True

    def open_platform_orders(self, page):
        self.selected = False

    def ensure_unshipped_filter(self, page):
        pass

    def count_rows(self, page):
        return len(self.orders)

    def read_order_numbers(self, page):
        return list(self.orders.keys())

    def select_all(self, page):
        if not self.orders:
            return False
        self.selected = True
        return True

    def set_courier(self, page, courier):
        if not self.selected:
            return False
        self.current_courier = courier
        self.courier_history.append(courier)
        return True

    def batch_ship(self, page):
        self.ship_rounds += 1
        shipped = [o for o, ok in self.orders.items()
                   if self.current_courier in ok]
        for o in shipped:
            del self.orders[o]
        self.selected = False
        return True


def install(scn):
    """把 scenario 的方法装到 wms / core 上，返回还原函数。"""
    saved = {
        "wms.open_platform_orders": wms.open_platform_orders,
        "wms.ensure_unshipped_filter": wms.ensure_unshipped_filter,
        "wms.count_rows": wms.count_rows,
        "wms.read_order_numbers": wms.read_order_numbers,
        "wms.select_all": wms.select_all,
        "wms.set_courier": wms.set_courier,
        "wms.batch_ship": wms.batch_ship,
        "core.wms_login": core.wms_login,
    }
    wms.open_platform_orders = scn.open_platform_orders
    wms.ensure_unshipped_filter = scn.ensure_unshipped_filter
    wms.count_rows = scn.count_rows
    wms.read_order_numbers = scn.read_order_numbers
    wms.select_all = scn.select_all
    wms.set_courier = scn.set_courier
    wms.batch_ship = scn.batch_ship
    core.wms_login = scn.wms_login

    def restore():
        wms.open_platform_orders = saved["wms.open_platform_orders"]
        wms.ensure_unshipped_filter = saved["wms.ensure_unshipped_filter"]
        wms.count_rows = saved["wms.count_rows"]
        wms.read_order_numbers = saved["wms.read_order_numbers"]
        wms.select_all = saved["wms.select_all"]
        wms.set_courier = saved["wms.set_courier"]
        wms.batch_ship = saved["wms.batch_ship"]
        core.wms_login = saved["core.wms_login"]
    return restore


def run_case(name, account, courier, orders, expect_history, expect_left_orders):
    scn = Scenario(orders)
    restore = install(scn)
    try:
        res = wms.process_shop(FakePage(), account, courier)
    finally:
        restore()

    left = sorted(res.get("left_orders") or [])
    ok_hist = scn.courier_history == expect_history
    ok_left = left == sorted(expect_left_orders)
    ok_rounds = scn.ship_rounds <= 1                      # 新规则：至多发一次
    ok = ok_hist and ok_left and ok_rounds and res.get("left", -1) == len(expect_left_orders)
    print(f"\n[用例] {name}")
    print(f"  渠道快递方: {courier}")
    print(f"  快递方设置顺序: {scn.courier_history}   期望: {expect_history}   {'OK' if ok_hist else 'X'}")
    print(f"  仍未发货订单:   {left}   期望: {sorted(expect_left_orders)}   {'OK' if ok_left else 'X'}")
    print(f"  发货轮数: {scn.ship_rounds}(应<=1) {'OK' if ok_rounds else 'X'}   before={res.get('before')} left={res.get('left')}")
    print(f"  => {'通过' if ok else '失败'}")
    return ok


def main():
    # 自测不碰真实系统；显式置 DRY_RUN 以防误触（mock 已接管交互函数，不受其影响）
    config.DRY_RUN = True
    黑猫 = {"login": "JMCAT", "shop": "黑猫"}
    金猫 = {"login": "JMSM", "shop": "金猫"}

    results = []

    # 用例1：金猫-RM 渠道，只改 RM 发一次；能 RM 发的发出，不能的留存（不换 DPD）
    results.append(run_case(
        "金猫-RM渠道-非RM单留存(不换)",
        金猫, "RM",
        orders={"P0001": {"RM"}, "P0002": {"RM"}, "P0003": {"DPD"}},
        expect_history=["RM"],
        expect_left_orders=["P0003"],
    ))

    # 用例2：金猫-DPD 渠道，只改 DPD 发一次
    results.append(run_case(
        "金猫-DPD渠道-非DPD单留存",
        金猫, "DPD",
        orders={"P0101": {"DPD"}, "P0102": {"RM"}},
        expect_history=["DPD"],
        expect_left_orders=["P0102"],
    ))

    # 用例3：黑猫-EH 渠道，只改 EH 发一次
    results.append(run_case(
        "黑猫-EH渠道-非EH单留存",
        黑猫, "EH",
        orders={"P0201": {"EH"}, "P0202": {"RM"}},
        expect_history=["EH"],
        expect_left_orders=["P0202"],
    ))

    # 用例4：黑猫-RM 渠道，全部能 RM 发 -> 一轮全发出，只设一次 RM
    results.append(run_case(
        "黑猫-RM渠道-一轮全发完",
        黑猫, "RM",
        orders={f"P03{i:02d}": {"RM"} for i in range(6)},
        expect_history=["RM"],
        expect_left_orders=[],
    ))

    # 用例5：金猫-RM 渠道，无一单能 RM 发 -> 全留存，仍只设一次 RM（不降级）
    results.append(run_case(
        "金猫-RM渠道-全失败全留存(不降级)",
        金猫, "RM",
        orders={"P0501": set(), "P0502": {"DPD"}},
        expect_history=["RM"],
        expect_left_orders=["P0501", "P0502"],
    ))

    print("\n" + "=" * 50)
    print(f"总计 {len(results)} 个用例，通过 {sum(results)} 个，失败 {len(results) - sum(results)} 个")
    sys.exit(0 if all(results) else 1)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""
WMS 发货编排自测（新规则，2026-07-09）：验证 process_shop「单一快递方一次发货」逻辑。

新规则：一个渠道对应唯一快递方（渠道末段 -RM/-DPD/-EH），WMS 这批单只改成那一个快递方、
发一次；能发的发出，发不出的留在'未发货'即留存提醒——**不换别的快递方、不轮转**。

这里用 mock 把 wms 模块里所有和浏览器交互的函数替换成纯内存假实现，只保留 process_shop 的
**编排逻辑**（全选/改快递方/发货一次、留存），从而不依赖真实系统验证正确性。

运行：  python capture/wms_rotation_selftest.py
不连任何系统、不需要登录，纯逻辑自测。
"""
import os, sys
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))))

import config, core, wms


class FakePage:
    """占位 page，mock 里不真正用它。"""
    pass


class Scenario:
    """模拟 WMS 未发货列表状态：
    orders = {订单号: 该单能成功发货的快递方集合}
    batch_ship 时，当前设置的快递方若在某单的可发集合里，则该单发出（离开列表）。
    """
    def __init__(self, orders, remote=None):
        self.orders = dict(orders)          # 剩余未发货
        self.remote = set(remote or [])     # 偏远地区(Y)订单号集合（需求2：应被排除、留存）
        self.non_remote_only = False        # 是否已设「是否偏远地区=否」筛选
        self.current_courier = None
        self.selected = False
        self.courier_history = []           # 依次设置过的快递方（新规则下应至多 1 个）
        self.ship_rounds = 0

    # ---- 下面这些替换 wms.* 与 core.wms_login ----
    def wms_login(self, page, account):
        return True

    def open_platform_orders(self, page):
        self.selected = False
        self.non_remote_only = False        # 页面重载会清掉偏远筛选（回到全部未发货）

    def ensure_unshipped_filter(self, page):
        pass

    def count_rows(self, page):
        return len(self.orders)

    def read_order_numbers(self, page):
        return list(self.orders.keys())

    def select_all(self, page):
        if not self.orders:
            return False
        self.selected = True
        return True

    def set_courier(self, page, courier):
        if not self.selected:
            return False
        self.current_courier = courier
        self.courier_history.append(courier)
        return True

    def set_remote_filter(self, page, value="否"):
        # 需求2：设「是否偏远地区=否」，之后全选/发货只作用于非偏远单
        self.non_remote_only = (value == "否")
        self.selected = False               # 查询刷新会丢勾选（真实行为）
        return True

    def batch_ship(self, page):
        self.ship_rounds += 1
        visible = {o: ok for o, ok in self.orders.items()
                   if not (self.non_remote_only and o in self.remote)}
        shipped = [o for o, ok in visible.items()
                   if self.current_courier in ok]
        for o in shipped:
            del self.orders[o]
        self.selected = False
        return True


def install(scn):
    """把 scenario 的方法装到 wms / core 上，返回还原函数。"""
    saved = {
        "wms.open_platform_orders": wms.open_platform_orders,
        "wms.ensure_unshipped_filter": wms.ensure_unshipped_filter,
        "wms.count_rows": wms.count_rows,
        "wms.read_order_numbers": wms.read_order_numbers,
        "wms.select_all": wms.select_all,
        "wms.set_courier": wms.set_courier,
        "wms.set_remote_filter": wms.set_remote_filter,
        "wms.batch_ship": wms.batch_ship,
        "core.wms_login": core.wms_login,
    }
    wms.open_platform_orders = scn.open_platform_orders
    wms.ensure_unshipped_filter = scn.ensure_unshipped_filter
    wms.count_rows = scn.count_rows
    wms.read_order_numbers = scn.read_order_numbers
    wms.select_all = scn.select_all
    wms.set_courier = scn.set_courier
    wms.set_remote_filter = scn.set_remote_filter
    wms.batch_ship = scn.batch_ship
    core.wms_login = scn.wms_login

    def restore():
        wms.open_platform_orders = saved["wms.open_platform_orders"]
        wms.ensure_unshipped_filter = saved["wms.ensure_unshipped_filter"]
        wms.count_rows = saved["wms.count_rows"]
        wms.read_order_numbers = saved["wms.read_order_numbers"]
        wms.select_all = saved["wms.select_all"]
        wms.set_courier = saved["wms.set_courier"]
        wms.set_remote_filter = saved["wms.set_remote_filter"]
        wms.batch_ship = saved["wms.batch_ship"]
        core.wms_login = saved["core.wms_login"]
    return restore


def run_case(name, account, courier, orders, expect_history, expect_left_orders, remote=None):
    scn = Scenario(orders, remote=remote)
    restore = install(scn)
    try:
        res = wms.process_shop(FakePage(), account, courier)
    finally:
        restore()

    left = sorted(res.get("left_orders") or [])
    ok_hist = scn.courier_history == expect_history
    ok_left = left == sorted(expect_left_orders)
    ok_rounds = scn.ship_rounds <= 1                      # 新规则：至多发一次
    ok = ok_hist and ok_left and ok_rounds and res.get("left", -1) == len(expect_left_orders)
    print(f"\n[用例] {name}")
    print(f"  渠道快递方: {courier}")
    print(f"  快递方设置顺序: {scn.courier_history}   期望: {expect_history}   {'OK' if ok_hist else 'X'}")
    print(f"  仍未发货订单:   {left}   期望: {sorted(expect_left_orders)}   {'OK' if ok_left else 'X'}")
    print(f"  发货轮数: {scn.ship_rounds}(应<=1) {'OK' if ok_rounds else 'X'}   before={res.get('before')} left={res.get('left')}")
    print(f"  => {'通过' if ok else '失败'}")
    return ok


def main():
    # 自测不碰真实系统；显式置 DRY_RUN 以防误触（mock 已接管交互函数，不受其影响）
    config.DRY_RUN = True
    黑猫 = {"login": "JMCAT", "shop": "黑猫"}
    金猫 = {"login": "JMSM", "shop": "金猫"}

    results = []

    # 用例1：金猫-RM 渠道，只改 RM 发一次；能 RM 发的发出，不能的留存（不换 DPD）
    results.append(run_case(
        "金猫-RM渠道-非RM单留存(不换)",
        金猫, "RM",
        orders={"P0001": {"RM"}, "P0002": {"RM"}, "P0003": {"DPD"}},
        expect_history=["RM"],
        expect_left_orders=["P0003"],
    ))

    # 用例2：金猫-DPD 渠道，只改 DPD 发一次
    results.append(run_case(
        "金猫-DPD渠道-非DPD单留存",
        金猫, "DPD",
        orders={"P0101": {"DPD"}, "P0102": {"RM"}},
        expect_history=["DPD"],
        expect_left_orders=["P0102"],
    ))

    # 用例3：黑猫-EH 渠道，只改 EH 发一次
    results.append(run_case(
        "黑猫-EH渠道-非EH单留存",
        黑猫, "EH",
        orders={"P0201": {"EH"}, "P0202": {"RM"}},
        expect_history=["EH"],
        expect_left_orders=["P0202"],
    ))

    # 用例4：黑猫-RM 渠道，全部能 RM 发 -> 一轮全发出，只设一次 RM
    results.append(run_case(
        "黑猫-RM渠道-一轮全发完",
        黑猫, "RM",
        orders={f"P03{i:02d}": {"RM"} for i in range(6)},
        expect_history=["RM"],
        expect_left_orders=[],
    ))

    # 用例5：金猫-RM 渠道，无一单能 RM 发 -> 全留存，仍只设一次 RM（不降级）
    results.append(run_case(
        "金猫-RM渠道-全失败全留存(不降级)",
        金猫, "RM",
        orders={"P0501": set(), "P0502": {"DPD"}},
        expect_history=["RM"],
        expect_left_orders=["P0501", "P0502"],
    ))

    print("\n" + "=" * 50)
    print(f"总计 {len(results)} 个用例，通过 {sum(results)} 个，失败 {len(results) - sum(results)} 个")
    sys.exit(0 if all(results) else 1)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""

# 店铺/账号 -> 快递方优先顺序

}

# WMS 快递方下拉里可选的全部渠道（用于校验）
ALL_COURIERS = ["DPD", "RM", "EH", "FEDEX"]

    """渠道名末段 -> WMS 快递方（RM/DPD/EH/FEDEX），一一对应（用户规则 2026-07-09）。
    取最后一个 '-' 分段并校验。例：
      '昇新海外仓-昇新海外仓-DPD' -> 'DPD'；'昇新海外仓-BLACKCAT-RM' -> 'RM'。
    解析不出合法快递方时返回 ''（调用方据此跳过发货并留存/提醒）。"""
    if not channel_name:
        return ""
    last = channel_name.strip().split("-")[-1].strip().upper()
    return last if last in ALL_COURIERS else ""


def courier_priority(shop_name: str) -> list:
    """（旧规则，2026-07-09 已弃用）曾按店铺返回快递方优先列表做 RM→DPD→EH 轮转重试。
    新规则改为「渠道末段 = 单一快递方」，见 channel_courier()。此函数保留仅作兼容/参考，勿再用于发货编排。"""
    if not shop_name:
        return list(DEFAULT_COURIER_ORDER)
    key = shop_name.strip()
    # 先精确，再包含匹配
    if key in COURIER_RULES:
        return list(COURIER_RULES[key])
    low = key.lower()
    for k, v in COURIER_RULES.items():
        if k.lower() in low or low in k.lower():
            return list(v)
    return list(DEFAULT_COURIER_ORDER)

17	def _ts():
18	    # 环境禁用无参 datetime.now()，用 time.time 转本地时间字符串
19	    return time.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S", time.localtime(time.time()))

27	    """三合一日志：
28	    1) 控制台打印（gbk 兜底，不因 emoji 崩）；
29	    2) 人类可读文本日志 logs/run_YYYYMMDD.log（带 [级别]）；
30	    3) 结构化审计流水 logs/events_YYYYMMDD.jsonl（一行一 JSON，供对账/统计）。
31	    兼容旧用法 log("...")；新增 log.info/warn/error 与 log.event(stage=..., ...)。"""
32	
33	    def __init__(self, name="run"):
34	        day = time.strftime("%Y%m%d", time.localtime(time.time()))
35	        self.path = os.path.join(config.LOG_DIR, f"{name}_{day}.log")
36	        self.event_path = os.path.join(config.LOG_DIR, f"events_{day}.jsonl")
37	
38	    @staticmethod
39	    def _infer_level(msg):
40	        m = str(msg)
41	        if any(k in m for k in ("[ERROR]", "报错", "崩溃", "异常退出", "Traceback")):
42	            return "ERROR"
43	        if any(k in m for k in ("[WARN]", "[!]", "⚠", "失败", "未找到", "未定位", "超时", "无法")):
44	            return "WARN"
45	        return "INFO"
46	
47	    def __call__(self, msg, level=None):
48	        level = level or self._infer_level(msg)
49	        line = f"[{_ts()}] [{level}] {msg}"
50	        try:
51	            print(line)
52	        except UnicodeEncodeError:
53	            # 控制台(gbk)打不出的字符(如 emoji)用 replace 兜底，不中断运行
54	            import sys
55	            enc = (sys.stdout.encoding or "gbk")
56	            print(line.encode(enc, "replace").decode(enc, "replace"))
57	        try:
58	            with open(self.path, "a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
59	                f.write(line + "\n")
60	        except Exception:
61	            pass
62	
63	    def info(self, msg):
64	        self(msg, "INFO")
65	
66	    def warn(self, msg):
67	        self(msg, "WARN")
68	
69	    def error(self, msg):
70	        self(msg, "ERROR")
71	
72	    def event(self, stage, **fields):
73	        """记录一条结构化审计事件（写 jsonl，并回显一行人类可读日志）。
74	        典型 stage：物流下单 / WMS改快递方 / WMS批量发货 / WMS发货汇总 / 获取跟踪号 / 运行开始 / 运行结束。
75	        fields 常见：channel, shop, account, courier, count, success, fail, orders(list) 等。"""
76	        rec = {"ts": _ts(), "run_id": RUN_ID,
77	               "dry_run": getattr(config, "DRY_RUN", None),
78	               "stage": stage}
79	        rec.update(fields)
80	        # 回显人类可读行（订单号列表压缩显示，避免刷屏）
81	        parts = []
82	        for k, v in fields.items():
83	            if isinstance(v, (list, tuple)):
84	                v = f"[{len(v)}条]" if len(v) > 6 else list(v)
85	            parts.append(f"{k}={v}")

87	        try:
88	            with open(self.event_path, "a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
89	                f.write(json.dumps(rec, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
90	        except Exception:
91	            pass
92	
93	    def begin_run(self, kind, **fields):
94	        self.info("=" * 60)
95	        self.event("运行开始", kind=kind, dry_run=getattr(config, "DRY_RUN", None), **fields)
96	        return time.time()
97	
98	    def end_run(self, kind, start_ts=None, **fields):
99	        if start_ts is not None:
100	            fields["elapsed_sec"] = round(time.time() - start_ts, 1)
101	        self.event("运行结束", kind=kind, **fields)

142	          let acc='';
143	          document.querySelectorAll('*').forEach(e=>{
144	            if(e.children.length || e.offsetParent===null) return;

146	            if(m) acc=m[1].trim();

158	    成功判定不只看'没跳回 login.html'，还要校验页面当前账号 == 目标账号。"""
159	    safe_goto(page, LOGIN_URL_WMS)
160	    time.sleep(1.5)

165	    except Exception as e:

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""
只读探测：确认『先选模板』会不会让渠道下拉里的可选渠道变少（=漏筛风险）。
对比同一『待处理』视图下：
  (A) 全新视图(无模板) 渠道下拉里所有渠道选项 + 每个 CHANNEL_ORDER 渠道筛出的单数
  (B) 选模板后        渠道下拉里所有渠道选项 + 每个 CHANNEL_ORDER 渠道筛出的单数
若 B 的渠道选项集合 == A，且每个渠道单数一致或仅因排除取消单而减少，则『先选模板』安全；
若 B 里某渠道消失/单数异常变 0 而 A 有单，则说明模板压制了渠道下拉 = 漏发风险。
只读：绝不点物流下单。输出 UTF-8：capture/dumps/erp_probe_chan_after_tpl.txt
"""
import sys, os, time
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))))
import config
config.DRY_RUN = True
import core, erp
from rules import CHANNEL_ORDER
from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright

out = []
def w(s=""):
    out.append(str(s))
    try: print(s)
    except Exception: pass


def channel_options(page):
    """打开渠道下拉，读所有可选渠道文本，再关掉。"""
    try:
        erp.dismiss_notifications(page)
        page.click("input[placeholder*='渠道']", timeout=5000, force=True)
        time.sleep(1.2)
        opts = page.evaluate(r"""() => [...document.querySelectorAll('span.main_label')]
            .filter(e=>e.offsetParent!==null).map(e=>(e.innerText||'').trim()).filter(Boolean)""")
        page.keyboard.press("Escape"); time.sleep(0.5)
        return sorted(set(opts))
    except Exception as e:
        w(f"  读渠道选项失败: {e}")
        return []


def counts_per_channel(page, use_template):
    res = {}
    for ch in CHANNEL_ORDER:
        erp.open_order_ship(page)
        erp.goto_view(page, "待处理")
        if use_template:
            erp.select_filter_template(page)
        ok = erp.filter_by_channel(page, ch)
        res[ch] = erp.count_orders(page) if ok else "筛选失败/未找到"
    return res


def main():
    with sync_playwright() as p:
        ctx = core.open_context(p)
        page = ctx.pages[0] if ctx.pages else ctx.new_page()
        try:
            if not core.ensure_erp(page):
                w("!! ERP 会话失效，先 python capture/erp_manual_login.py")
                return

            erp.open_order_ship(page); erp.goto_view(page, "待处理")
            w(f"(A) 无模板 渠道下拉选项 = {channel_options(page)}")

            erp.open_order_ship(page); erp.goto_view(page, "待处理")
            erp.select_filter_template(page)
            w(f"(B) 选模板后 渠道下拉选项 = {channel_options(page)}")

            w("\n每渠道筛出单数：")
            a = counts_per_channel(page, use_template=False)
            b = counts_per_channel(page, use_template=True)
            for ch in CHANNEL_ORDER:
                flag = "" if a.get(ch) == b.get(ch) else "  <- 不同"
                w(f"  {ch}:  无模板={a.get(ch)}   有模板={b.get(ch)}{flag}")
        finally:
            try: ctx.close()
            except Exception: pass

    path = os.path.join(config.DUMP_DIR, "erp_probe_chan_after_tpl.txt")
    with open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write("\n".join(out))
    print("WROTE", path)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
